verdict.rationale: Riskified's Beacon SDK captures device/session/behavioral data automatically and the /decide, /submit, /advise APIs ingest standard order/transaction payloads, and Plaid integration adds account-level signals — but the docs describe fixed schemas and platform-collected signals rather than a documented way for developers to inject arbitrary custom metadata or bespoke scoring signals into the model. Missing for 10: explicit custom-field/metadata API for developer-defined signals, documentation on how custom signals influence scoring weights, and any independent confirmation that non-standard fields are actually used in decisioning.
